pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, De Sancto Andrea Apostolo (resurrection of the young man at Nicaea)
pairs.question: Quid dabis mihi, si suscitavero filium tuum?
pairs.answer: Nil carius ego possidebam, ipsum ergo tibi dabo.
pairs.derivation: Andreas asks the father a genuine interrogative; the father answers directly. Dropped the speech tags 'Dixitque patri:' before and 'Cui ille:' before the answer. Normalized terminal punctuation (added '?'; the source lacks a closing quote/question mark after 'filium tuum').

pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, De Sancto Andrea Apostolo (Episcopus atque Diabolus, first riddle)
pairs.question: Quod est maius mirabile, quod Deus umquam in parva re fecerit?
pairs.derivation: The woman (devil) proposes the riddle; the peregrinus (Andreas) answers. Question: dropped the asking-frame 'Interrogetur,' before 'quod est maius mirabile'; normalized capitalization and terminal '?'. Answer: kept only the first answering sentence to the first full stop; cut at the colon, omitting the following elaboration 'Inter tot enim homines... Deus collocavit.' Dropped the answer's speech tag 'Interrogatus de hoc peregrinus per nuntium dixit:'.

pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, De Sancto Andrea Apostolo (Episcopus atque Diabolus, second riddle)
pairs.question: Ubi terra sit altior omni coelo?
pairs.answer: In coelo empyreo, ubi residet corpus Christi.
pairs.derivation: Question: dropped the asking-frame 'Proponatur sibi secunda quaestio gravior, in qua melius possumus sapientiam eius experiri: Quaeratur ab eo,' before 'ubi terra sit altior omni coelo'; normalized capitalization and terminal '?'. Answer: kept the first answering sentence to the first full stop; cut before the explanatory elaboration 'Corpus enim Christi... terra altior coelo manet.' Dropped the speech tag 'Percunctatus de hoc peregrinus respondit:'.

pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, De Sancto Andrea Apostolo (Episcopus atque Diabolus, third riddle)
pairs.question: Quanti spatii sit a terra usque in coelum?
pairs.answer: Vade ad eum, qui te misit ad me et de hoc diligenter percunctare.
pairs.derivation: Question: dropped the asking-frame 'Fiet ei tertia quaestio gravissima... Quaeratur ab eo,' before 'quanti spatii sit a terra usque in coelum'; normalized capitalization and terminal '?'. Answer: kept the operative deflecting answer (the riddle's point, that the devil himself measured the distance when he fell) to the first full stop; cut before 'Ipse enim melius me hoc novit... in similitudinem mulieris.' Dropped the speech tag 'Requisitus de hoc peregrinus nuntio dixit:'.
